settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile, location, fields and password.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Changes the language at once and is saved to your account.
profile.name: Full name
profile.locationHint: Used later for weather and irrigation advice for your area. Only you and the admins can see it.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

location.title: Location (latitude, longitude)
location.invalid: Enter both latitude and longitude of a place in India, or leave both empty.

errors.unsupported: This device or browser cannot share its location.
errors.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow it in the browser settings or type the values.
errors.unavailable: Could not get your location. Try again outdoors or type the values.
errors.outside: The location found is outside India. Please type your farm's location.

fields.title: My fields
fields.subtitle: Area is stored in acres; 40 guntha = 1 acre.
fields.dialogHint: Only the name and area are required.
fields.name: Field name
fields.areaInvalid: Enter an area greater than zero.
fields.emptyBody: Add your plots to track costs per field and, later, get advice for each one.
fields.deleteBody: The field is removed. Farm-account entries linked to it keep their amounts but will no longer show a field.

ledger.title: Farm accounts
ledger.subtitle: Your income and expenses. Delivered marketplace orders and completed equipment rentals are added automatically.
ledger.emptyBody: Add your income and expenses, or change the period. Orders and rentals appear here once delivered or completed.
ledger.deleteBody: It will be removed from your accounts.
ledger.deleteLinkedBody: This entry came from an order or booking. Deleting it removes it from your accounts only; the order or booking is not changed.

form.linkedHint: This entry comes from an order or booking: only the category, field and note can be changed.
form.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.

dashboard.subtitle: Your orders, bookings, questions and accounts at a glance.
dashboard.comingTitle: Weather, mandi prices and crop advice — coming in the next phase
dashboard.comingBody: These will use real data for your fields' location once they are ready. Nothing is shown until then.
